items.name: isitmyisp
items.description: Self-hosted, open source (MIT) connectivity monitor for small businesses. It tells you in one sentence whose fault the outage is (Wi-Fi/router, the ISP's access network, backbone, a service or DNS) and builds the evidence report for the ISP claim: a summary for the customer and a technical annex with mtr captures for the NOC. 5 releases on Docker Hub (amd64/arm64), 277 automated tests and a public demo in Spanish and English.
